verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API-driven financial platform, so bulk operations are a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints that act on many items at once. The 'all in one call' orchestrations chain several steps for a single conversion and transfer rather than acting across many items. Listing and paging transfers is a bulk read, not a bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
